title: Backward SDEs-based Diffusion for Physics-Constrained Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.15702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pretrained score-based diffusion models provide strong unconditional priors, yet enforcing measurement or physics consistency in inverse problems is often handled by heuristic guidance, intermittent projections, or task-specific conditional training, with limited guarantees of feasibility at the end of inference. We propose terminal-conditioned inversion for score-based SDE priors. Given a frozen Score-SDE prior and a task-defined terminal feasibility specification, we construct an associated backward stochastic differential equation whose adapted solution defines a principled inverse map from the terminal requirement to a prior state at a chosen noise level. Under standard regularity conditions, we establish existence and uniqueness of the adapted solution and obtain terminal consistency by construction. We further develop a practical neural BSDE solver that composes arbitrary pretrained diffusion priors with domain constraints without

translated_title: 基于后向随机微分方程的物理约束扩散生成方法
translated_abstract: 预训练的基于分数的扩散模型提供了强大的无条件先验，然而在逆问题中强制执行测量或物理一致性时，通常依赖于启发式引导、间歇性投影或针对特定任务的条件训练，且在推理结束时对可行性的保证十分有限。我们提出了一种针对基于分数的SDE先验的终端条件化反演方法。给定一个冻结的Score-SDE先验和任务定义的终端可行性规范，我们构造一个与之相关的后向随机微分方程（BSDE），其适应解定义了一个从终端约束条件到所选噪声水平下先验状态的有原则性的逆映射。在标准正则性条件下，我们证明了该适应解的存在性和唯一性，并通过构造方式获得了终端一致性保证。我们进一步开发了一种实用的神经BSDE求解器，能够将任意预训练的扩散先验与领域约束相结合而无需……
tldr: 提出了一种基于后向随机微分方程（BSDE）的终端条件化反演方法，可将冻结的预训练分数扩散先验与物理约束相结合，通过构造保证解的终端可行性，为逆问题求解提供了有理论保证的原则性框架。
en_tdlr: Proposes a terminal-conditioned inversion method based on backward stochastic differential equations (BSDEs) that composes frozen pretrained score-based diffusion priors with physics constraints, guaranteeing terminal feasibility by construction and providing a principled framework for solving inverse problems.
